name: guiwei
what: a 桂味 (Guiwei) lychee for the film: near-round, sharp tubercles (片峰尖锐刺手), a clear suture, fresh. Lengths in mm. Tags as materials/lychee/material.json.

D_mm.source: a sphere of 22.53 g [M, casb2023: Guiwei, Yongde] at density 1.0 g/cm3 [A] is 35.0 mm across; 34 with the tubercles standing out of the envelope

L_over_D.source: 近圆球形 (near-round) in cultivar descriptions [I, popular]; Brewster is 38.62/36.10 = 1.07 [M, nacif2001]

shoulder.source: cordiform: the stem end broader than the apex (nacif2001 calls the ripe fruit heart-shaped); x scale (1 + k cos theta)

spacing_over_D.source: the card's photo (leidus2021), plates counted face-on at the fruit's centre on a 100 px grid: about 220 px for a fruit 2280 px across (mean of the limb ellipse's axes); taken over to Guiwei [A]

height_over_D.source: the card's fruit: limb prominence median 0.018 D (max 0.032 D) [M, materials/lychee/measure_ref.py], taken over to Guiwei [A]. S4: 0.03 first (the upper value, for Guiwei's sharper plates, 片峰尖锐刺手 [I]): at the section's 8 degree view the skin beyond the cut stood up as a range of hills, where the look target's rim is a low crust; the sharpness stays in q and the facets

sharpness_q.source: h = H (e/e_max)^q, e the distance to the plate's border: q 1 a pyramid, > 1 concave flanks and a sharp peak (不规则圆锥状, 片峰尖锐)

jitter.source: plate centres: a Fibonacci lattice moved by up to this many spacings

spacing_over_plate.source: the plates are divided again into smaller facets (the card's photo, ref/lychee: finer divisions inside the plates [M, qualitative]; Guiwei's plates sharp and prickly [I, cultivar descriptions]); about three across a plate, not counted

height_over_H.source: not measured; S4: 0.35 first: the plates' peaks still read as single smooth hills at 2.55x, where the look target's edge is a fine sawtooth

across_mm.source: fine fissures across the plates (the card's photo, ref/lychee: radial cracks and a granular face [M, qualitative]); width not measured

px_mm.source: texels at the equator: the section's pixel is 7 um

depth_mm.source: 缝合线明显, deep and narrow [I, cultivar descriptions]

thickness_mm.source: Guiwei's pericarp is thin and brittle [I, popular descriptions]: near the low end of 0.74-3.13 mm over 120 accessions [M, yuan2023]. S4: 0.9 first, which drew the white layer a wide band

outer_mm.source: the red layer: from the tubercles' surface down to this far under the grooves' level, so the tubercles are red through (a cut fruit's rim is mostly red, ref/lychee/commons2, Filo gen', by eye) [A]; the white layer is the rest of the pericarp's thickness

layer_gap_mm.source: between the two layers: an artefact of the renderers' one medium per closed surface (material.json model)

pericarp_aril_mm.source: the endocarp often separates from the aril (nacif2001)

aril_seed_mm.source: the aril grows from the funicle and wraps the seed (nacif2001; PCP 2015); not attached over the seed's surface

length_mm.source: the edible rate 76.61 % [M, casb2023] leaves 23.4 % of 22.53 g for pericarp and seed; pericarp about 3 g (0.9 mm x the envelope's area x 0.9 g/cm3 [A]) leaves about 2.2 g for the seed, an ellipsoid of about 1.9 cm3 at 1.15 g/cm3 [A], 20 x 13 x 11.5 mm with the card photo's seed proportions [M]. Guiwei often has a shrivelled seed (焦核, 44 % in Yongde): a plump one here

centre_z_mm.source: towards the stem, where the aril grows from

mesh.source: outer surface sampled finer than a pixel at the section's framing (about 0.02 mm/px at 1920); smooth surfaces coarser
